title: Keep account projects current
responsibility: Refreshes account projects when a device becomes active, without overlapping requests or polling hidden pages.

inputs.name: refresh
inputs.description: Reads the current account and its projects. The caller reports any failure.

inputs.name: interval
inputs.description: Time between visible-page refreshes in milliseconds; defaults to 30000.

outputs.name: sync
outputs.description: Coalesces repeated requests into at most one follow-up read. Stopping releases listeners and timers.
